capabilities: Render wikilinks through templates filled with linked-file frontmatter values
Apply templates conditionally based on headings or link destinations
Skip or force a template on individual links with inline %%ew:%% markers
Insert link metadata via built-in values like {this.title} and {this.tags}
Style rendered links with CSS classes per template
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian wikilinks have a fixed appearance, so users cannot show icons, tags, or custom text pulled from the linked note's frontmatter.
summary: Wikilink renderer that rewrites link display using frontmatter-driven templates with conditional rules and per-link overrides.
